versions.changelog:
- Added a new “Reviews & testimonials” section summarizing LabEx learner feedback about hands-on labs, interactive practice, and structured learning paths.
- Included example quotes from public LabEx reviews and a link to more reviews.
- Highlighted recurring themes from learner feedback, such as the value of lab-first training and clear course progression.
- Clarified in the introduction that users can find [Learn DevOps](https://labex.io/learn/devops) content on LabEx directly.
- No functional workflow or API changes; focuses on expanding user guidance and trust through public testimonials.

Initial release—DevOps-focused skill for LabEx:

- Guides users to LabEx DevOps courses and hands-on labs via public catalog endpoints.
- Recommends concise, actionable learning paths strictly within the DevOps category.
- Prioritizes brief explanations and provides public lab URLs for seamless browser access.
- Interacts only with public catalog routes, avoiding private or unrelated resources.
